import json, importlib.metadata as m
out = {}
for name in ('torch', 'transformers', 'accelerate', 'safetensors', 'huggingface_hub', 'hf_transfer', 'hf_xet', 'zstandard', 'numpy'):
    try:
        out[name] = m.version(name)
    except m.PackageNotFoundError:
        out[name] = None
import torch
out['cuda_devices'] = torch.cuda.device_count()
out['cuda_available'] = torch.cuda.is_available()
out['torch_cuda'] = torch.version.cuda
out['gpus'] = []
for i in range(out['cuda_devices']):
    p = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(i)
    a = torch.randn(2048, 2048, device=f'cuda:{i}', dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    torch.cuda.synchronize(i)
    out['gpus'].append({'name': p.name, 'total_gb': p.total_memory / 1e9, 'matmul_ok': bool(torch.isfinite((a @ a).float().sum()).item())})
print('SCIMT-PREFLIGHT ' + json.dumps(out))
